Stone third-party components
============================

This file identifies the third-party code retained in this source tree.
The referenced license files and source notices remain authoritative.
All source-tree paths below are relative to the repository root.

Zydis 4.1.1 and Zycore
  Purpose: x86 instruction decoding/encoding for the Windows x64 ART bridge.
  License: MIT.
  Notices: oss/zydis/LICENSE, oss/zydis/dependencies/zycore/LICENSE.
  Revisions and upstream: docs/third-party/zydis.md.

XZ Embedded
  Purpose: decode ELF .gnu_debugdata.
  License: BSD Zero Clause (0BSD).
  Notice: oss/xz-embedded/COPYING.
  Revision and upstream: docs/third-party/xz-embedded.md.

AOSP Bionic error description data
  Purpose: Android errno names and descriptions in the Windows libc bridge.
  License: BSD 2-Clause.
  Notice: oss/bionic/LICENSE and oss/bionic/errno-descriptions.inc.
  Source identities and adaptation: docs/third-party/bionic.md.

erofs-utils compact index lookup
  Purpose: C++ adaptation in src/windows/image-tools/Erofs.cpp.
  License: Apache License 2.0.
  Notices and source revision: oss/erofs-utils/LICENSE, oss/erofs-utils/NOTICE.
  Both notices are distributed in licenses/erofs-utils/ beside StoneImageTool.exe.

miniz 3.1.2
  Purpose: native ZIP/APEX extraction and CRC verification in StoneImageTool.
  License: MIT.
  Source, hashes and build configuration: oss/miniz/README.stone.md.
  Notice: oss/miniz/LICENSE, distributed as licenses/miniz-MIT.txt.

ANGLE / Khronos headers
  Purpose: Windows graphics API declarations.
  Notices: oss/angle/LICENSE and individual header notices in oss/angle/include.
  ANGLE DLLs are external runtime dependencies and are not bundled here.

Vulkan headers
  Purpose: Vulkan bridge API declarations.
  License: Apache License 2.0 and the notices in individual headers.
  Notice: oss/vulkan/LICENSE.txt.

SQLite headers
  Purpose: SQLite bridge API declarations.
  SQLite is in the public domain; see the notices in oss/sqlite/sqlite3.h.
  The actual Android SQLite library comes from the selected system image.

Windows settings dependencies
  Purpose: WinUI 3 desktop settings UI and Native AOT / trimmed publication.
  Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK: version pinned by STONE_SETTINGS_WINDOWS_APP_SDK_VERSION
  in src/windows/settings/CMakeLists.txt; Microsoft Software License Terms in
  the restored NuGet package's license.txt. Upstream: microsoft/WindowsAppSDK.
  Microsoft.Windows.SDK.BuildTools: build-only Windows SDK tools; version pinned
  by STONE_SETTINGS_WINDOWS_SDK_BUILDTOOLS_VERSION. Terms: https://aka.ms/WinSDKLicenseURL.
  .NET runtime / Native AOT: supplied by the selected .NET SDK and runtime packs.
  License: MIT, with additional third-party notices from the runtime package.
  Upstream: https://github.com/dotnet/runtime.
  Settings builds copy the Windows App SDK license and resolved .NET runtime
  license/notices into the output licenses directory. Preserve the licenses
  and notices of any additional restored packages when redistributing them.

Windows packaging tools and redistributables
  WiX Toolset 4.0.6: https://github.com/wixtoolset/wix (MS-RL).
  Build-only external tool, installed separately; not embedded in Stone packages.
  MakeAppx, MakePri and SignTool: external Windows SDK build tools under the
  Windows SDK license; not embedded in Stone packages.
  Native MSVC runtime DLLs: copied from the selected Visual Studio toolchain's
  redistributable directory using CMake InstallRequiredSystemLibraries.
  Redistribution is subject to the installed Visual Studio license and REDIST
  terms: https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/license-terms/.
  Windows JDKs, Android images and ANGLE DLLs are not added by packaging.

System-image components
  ART, the AOSP Java framework, system fonts, Conscrypt, Android native
  libraries and their dependencies are read from the user-selected Android
  system image. They are not redistributed in this repository. Preserve
  the image supplier's licenses and notices when distributing an image.

README hero artwork: Microsoft Fluent UI System Icons (Color)
  Source: https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-system-icons
  Revision: a3de63245b4fa49c30e20d9838593a105affe774
  Copyright (c) 2020 Microsoft Corporation. License: MIT.
  Original SVG assets and license terms are available from the upstream source
  at the revision above. The hero composition scales and positions
  these original icons without redrawing their shapes or changing their colors.
  These files are documentation artwork only and add no runtime dependency.
